items.title: Awesome Cl
items.content_text:
### Shells, shells interfaces / Third-party APIs

*   [cclsh (⭐24)](https://github.com/lambda-symbolics/cclsh) - A system shell running inside Common Lisp. Ordinary Unix commands and Common Lisp forms share one live image, so the boundary between shell use and Lisp is small and explicit. ISC license.
    *   for CCL on Linux x86-64, also SBCL on macOS and Linux.

items.title: Awesome Rust
items.content_text:
### Applications / Image processing

*   [heydeer/pngdeer (⭐242)](https://github.com/heydeer/pngdeer) - A lossy PNG compressor with automatic perceptual quality selection, available as a Rust CLI and WebAssembly app. [![CI](https://github.com/heydeer/pngdeer/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/heydeer/pngdeer/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Applications / Productivity

*   [emanuele-em/kanzo (⭐53)](https://github.com/emanuele-em/kanzo) \[[kanzo](https://crates.io/crates/kanzo)] - Self-hosted kanban board for humans and coding agents: a web board and an MCP server in one binary, with data in a local SQLite folder [![CI](https://github.com/emanuele-em/kanzo/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/emanuele-em/kanzo/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Libraries / Cryptography

*   [dsse (⭐0)](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence/tree/main/crates/dsse) \[[dsse](https://crates.io/crates/dsse)] - DSSE (Dead Simple Signing Envelope) envelopes with PAE pre-authentication encoding: construction, signing and threshold verification, as used by in-toto and Sigstore attestations.

items.title: Open Source Mac Os Apps
items.content_text:
### ⏱️ Productivity (152) / ✏️ Text (18) * [Earshot (⭐11)](https://github.com/Bouliw/earshot) - Live on-device transcription of any app you pick, with speaker names in Microsoft Teams. **Languages:** Swift
Screenshots

* [JoeBro (⭐91)](https://github.com/joexk1/JoeBro) - Native AI workspace with a local Python backend. Chat, documents, memory, MCP tools and deep research, using local models or any API. **Languages:** Swift Python **Website:**
Screenshots

* [Nogrammerly (⭐8)](https://github.com/gaurabh-pei/nogrammerly) - On-device writing assistant that checks spelling, grammar and tone and rewrites text in any app, using Apple Intelligence. **Languages:** Swift **Website:** [https://github.com/gaurabh-pei/nogrammerly (⭐8)](https://github.com/gaurabh-pei/nogrammerly)
Screenshots

### ⌨️ Keyboard (15) / ✏️ Text (18) * [KeyEcho (⭐876)](https://github.com/ZacharyL2/KeyEcho) - Plays recorded mechanical keyboard sounds as you type. **Languages:** Rust TypeScript **Website:**
Screenshots

### 📊 Menubar (157) / ✏️ Text (18) * [Muster (⭐71)](https://github.com/josefchen/muster) - Menu bar app that monitors Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions, answers Claude Code and Codex permission prompts from alerts, and switches sessions with Option-Tab. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 👨‍💻 Development (55) / 📦 Git (23) * [GithubStarsManager (⭐3.8k)](https://github.com/AmintaCCCP/GithubStarsManager) - AI-powered, local-first app to organize your GitHub stars with auto-summaries, tags, semantic search, and release tracking. **Languages:** TypeScript **Website:**
Screenshots

### 👨‍💻 Development (55) / 🔧 Other Development (8) * [JET Pilot (⭐630)](https://github.com/unxsist/jet-pilot) - Open-source Kubernetes desktop client for working across clusters, namespaces and cloud accounts, with multi-cluster views, a resource graph, structured logs and a built-in kubectl terminal. **Languages:** Rust TypeScript vue **Website:**
Screenshots

### ⬇️ Downloader (11) / 📱 iOS / macOS (46) * [Arroxy (⭐792)](https://github.com/antonio-orionus/Arroxy) - Video and audio downloader powered by yt-dlp, with a built-in browser, playlists, subtitles and download profiles. **Languages:** TypeScript **Website:**
Screenshots

### 🛠️ Utilities (227) / ✏️ Text (18) * [Strata Files (⭐130)](https://github.com/cristipufu/strata-files) - Fast, keyboard-first file manager and Finder alternative with instant search, live folder sizes, a disk usage map and dual pane. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [Bulchimbeon (⭐47)](https://github.com/s3onghyun/bulchimbeon) - Menu bar app that keeps the Mac awake only while AI coding agents are working, with lid-closed mode and heat and battery safeguards. **Languages:** Swift **Website:** [https://github.com/s3onghyun/bulchimbeon (⭐47)](https://github.com/s3onghyun/bulchimbeon)
Screenshots

* [Clip’M (⭐8)](https://github.com/Frazer/clipM) - Clipboard manager with searchable history, previews, reusable snippets, and paste transformations. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [Kopi (⭐6)](https://github.com/code-devanshu/kopi) - Local-first clipboard manager with searchable history, pinboards and plain-text paste. Skips password manager copies. **Languages:** Rust TypeScript Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [OpenClean (⭐38)](https://github.com/leoAnimesh/OpenClean) - Free Mac cleaner that explains each item, quarantines what it removes for undo, and includes an app uninstaller, disk map and menu bar monitor. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### ⚙️ System (47) / ✏️ Text (18) * [ftop (⭐241)](https://github.com/Nongfsq/ftop) - Floating system monitor for Apple Silicon that adapts its layout to any window size, showing per-core usage and frequency, GPU, memory pressure, and network. **Languages:** Swift **Website:** [https://github.com/Nongfsq/ftop (⭐241)](https://github.com/Nongfsq/ftop)
Screenshots

### 🪟 Window Management (27) / ✏️ Text (18) * [LayoutKeeper (⭐23)](https://github.com/tumingke0/LayoutKeeper) - Remembers window layouts per external monitor and restores position, size and Space (macOS 26+) on reconnect, with DDC brightness keys on Apple Silicon. **Languages:** Swift
Screenshots

### 📺 Terminal (27) / ✏️ Text (18) * [Termstead (⭐17)](https://github.com/pkhorenyan/termstead) - Native SSH client with a session tree, jump hosts, split panes and SFTP beside the terminal. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

items.title: Awesome Mac
items.content_text:
### Design and Product / Screenshot Tools

*   [Photon](https://www.piedol.top/photon/) - Open-source screenshot, markup and screen recording tool for macOS and Windows, with no network code. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/piedol/photon) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Design and Product / Other Tools

*   [Anthora](https://barryanders.github.io/anthora/) - Local photo and video library for browsing, searching, and reviewing duplicates across folders and mounted drives. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/barryanders/Anthora) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

*   [ParrotFlow](https://parrotflow.io/) - Local dictation app that you can program with your rules, scripts, and vocabulary. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/znat/parrotflow) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")
*   [Tamka](https://www.piedol.top/tamka/) - Open-source on-device dictation that runs NVIDIA Parakeet models on the Neural Engine and types at the cursor in any app. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/piedol/tamka) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Browsers / Audio Record and Process

*   [Lilo](https://getlilo.app/) - Native WebKit browser with Arc-style spaces, Chrome extensions, terminal tabs in the sidebar, and a built-in MCP server for AI agents. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/Alexays/Lilo) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

*   [Kipimo](https://www.piedol.top/kipimo/) - Open-source menu bar system monitor with tools to clear caches, uninstall apps with their leftovers, find what fills the disk and review startup items, moving everything to the Trash. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/piedol/kipimo) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

items.title: Awesome Amazon Seller
items.content_text:
### Software and Tools

*   [Firecrawl](https://www.firecrawl.dev) - Web scraping and search API for Amazon data. Scrape public Amazon pages as markdown (tested on Amazon.com, Amazon.co.uk and Amazon.de), or use structured data providers for Amazon.com (product details, prices, buy-box offers, reviews, search), Amazon.com.br and Amazon.nl.
*   [Off Hours](https://www.off-hours.app) - Amazon Ads scheduling and automation for Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts in all marketplaces across the North America, Europe and Far East regions. Runs dayparting, budget, event, performance and bid-adjustment rules on schedules and conditions the seller defines, checked every 15 minutes. Flat $149 per month per Amazon Ads account, never a percentage of ad spend. 14-day free trial.
